name: 千鸟
description: 选择正方向空地格（6），冲刺至该格，并对路径上所有敌人造成攻击力的伤害。对其施加定身[1]。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var pos = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 6, filter: 'all' }); if (!pos || pos.needsTargetSelection) return pos; if (pos.x !== caster.x && pos.y !== caster.y) return { success: false, message: '千鸟只能冲刺至同一行或同一列的格子' }; var dist = Math.abs(pos.x - caster.x) + Math.abs(pos.y - caster.y); if (dist === 0 || dist > 6) return { success: false, message: '目标距离必须在1-6格内' }; var tile = battle.map.tiles.find(function(item) { return item.x === pos.x && item.y === pos.y; }); if (!tile || !tile.props || !tile.props.walkable) return { success: false, message: '目标格不可行走' }; if (battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && piece.x === pos.x && piece.y === pos.y; })) return { success: false, message: '目标位置已有棋子' }; var trace = flow.query.tracePath(caster, {x:Math.sign(pos.x-caster.x),y:Math.sign(pos.y-caster.y)}, {excludePieceId:caster.instanceId,maxDistance:dist,passAllies:true,passEnemies:true,terrain:'any'}); var enemies = trace.encounters.filter(function(e){return e.type==='piece';}).map(function(e){return flow.query.piece(e.pieceId);}).filter(function(p){return p && !arePlayersAllied(battle,p.ownerPlayerId,caster.ownerPlayerId);}); if (!flow.effects.move([{pieceId:caster.instanceId,x:pos.x,y:pos.y}], 'dash', {"passAllies":true,"passEnemies":true,"terrain":"any"}).success) return {success:true,message:'位移被阻挡，本次位移效果取消'}; var damage = Math.floor(caster.attack * context.skill.powerMultiplier); if (enemies.length) { dealDamage(caster, enemies, damage, 'physical', battle, context.skill.id); enemies.forEach(function(enemy) { if (enemy.currentHp <= 0) return; var existing = enemy.statusTags && enemy.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'chidori-immobile'; }); if (existing) { existing.currentDuration = 1; existing.remainingDuration = 1; } else { addStatusEffectById(enemy.instanceId, { id: 'chidori-immobile-' + enemy.instanceId, name: '被千鸟贯穿', type: 'chidori-immobile', currentDuration: 1, remainingDuration: 1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, relatedRules: ['rule-chidori-immobile'] }); addRuleById(enemy.instanceId, 'rule-chidori-immobile'); } }); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '发动千鸟，冲刺至(' + pos.x + ',' + pos.y + ')并贯穿' + enemies.length + '名敌人' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { var damage = Math.floor((piece.attack || 0) * skillDef.powerMultiplier); return { description: "选择正方向空地格（6），冲刺至该格，并对路径上所有敌人造成攻击力的伤害。对其施加定身[1]。", expectedValues: { damage: damage, range: 6 } }; }
